name: HALT-ONE-gap
note: HALT-ONE (2026-10-05, Mac: "reduce the HALT noise"): the one voice without its gap - every frame a call

name: HALT-ONE-nearest
old: for (const c of callers) if (c.dist < near.dist) near = c;
new: for (const c of callers) if (c.dist > near.dist) near = c;
note: HALT-ONE: the farthest watchman calls, not the nearest

name: HALT-ONE-window
note: HALT-ONE: the call under a window

name: HALT-ONE-end

name: HALT-ONE-lane-unread
note: HALT-ONE: the living lane unread - every watchman his own clock again

name: HALT-ONE-anyone-calls
old: if (d < ATTRACT_RADIUS && watchStands(g)) calling.push({ g, dist: d });
new: if (d < ATTRACT_RADIUS) calling.push({ g, dist: d });
note: HALT-ONE: a defender, a pacified or a running watchman calling

name: HALT-ONE-radius-unread
old: if (d < ATTRACT_RADIUS && watchStands(g)) calling.push({ g, dist: d });
